body:
Tough love from a tough crystal, Malachite is the friend you go to when you need unfiltered relationship or life advice. As a protective stone that brings balance to the mind and spirit, you'll want to keep this malachite stone on your altar to ensure that its sacred wisdom is never far away.

Malachite is the ideal crystal for someone who never seems to find the perfect partner. Because it connects with and opens the heart chakra, malachite gives you the strength to breakthrough negative patterns. Stop repeating the same mistakes, and meditate with the malachite healing properties to identify problems and discover new directions. Once you have recognized the patterns that you need to free yourself from, malachite's infusion energy in your solar plexus chakra will provide a heavy dose of willpower to help you keep your intention of avoiding the same pitfalls. With this confident determination, not only will you be able to refrain from sliding backward into familiar traps, you'll experience a vitality that will propel you toward making positive decisions in other areas of your life.

Malachite has always been a stone of wisdom. Even in Ancient Egypt, malachite lined the inside of pharaoh's headdresses because it was believed that the crystal would lend balance and insight to his rule. Dating as far back as 3000 BC, malachite was also ground up into powder and used as eye makeup due to its vibrant color. Talk about having wise eyes!

As a powerful stone of transformation, the Malachite meaning will balance your emotions with stabilizing sensibility, so that you can form rational decisions that aren't clouded by heated emotions. In assisting you to break the cycle of placing blame on others, you will begin to take responsibility for yourself and transform into a pillar of strength and independence.

If you are pulled toward the energy of a Malachite stone, it could mean that it's time for a change. Malachite helps you search within for the transformation you need, and then pushes you to take action. Your soul knows what to do, and with malachite by your side, you can make that change happen.
